answer: For the 2025 target of no water-quality impacts from manufacturing effluents, 97% of own manufacturing sites and 100% of high-risk suppliers met all three maturity-ladder levels; Novartis considered the targets met. Sites without API discharges are deemed low risk and assumed compliant, antibody-only sites are exempt from effluent risk assessments, and all other manufacturing sites are included. High-risk suppliers are strategic, tactical or antibiotics providers; the list was defined in 2021, updated in 2025 for the Sandoz spin-off and divestments, with no new suppliers added.
